Closed LineI power chains associate left in Complex and scalar Matrix/Vector calculations:2^(3)^(2)=64,2^(-3)^(2)=0.015625. Nested exponents retain512. For actual complex base,(1+i)^(2)^(3)=-8i.

MathI power and square keys after leaving a superscript are ignored. A following baseline digit produces Syntax ERROR. Complex error and Back now share the scalar structured-input check. 0^0 produces Math ERROR in Complex and scalar Matrix/Vector.

LineI square and reciprocal after a closed exponent apply to the completed power:2^(3)²=64 and2^(3)⁻¹=0.125. MathI square after leaving superscript is ignored, retaining8. Parser postfixes are applied after each completed PLUS power; legacy associativity is unchanged.

A real2x2 diagonal MatA=(1,2) was entered. MatA² and MatA²⁻¹ return diagonal(1,4) and(1,0.25). The literal caret key can be entered after MatA, but execution of MatA^(2), a caret chain or caret inverse/zero exponent gives Syntax ERROR. These probes were renamed to observed errors; they are not claimed as valid matrix powers. VctA^(2) gives Math ERROR.

Complex LineI defaults to decimal for the negative power chain, following the same explicit-fraction input rule as Calculate. The pure-imaginary leading minus uses the unary glyph. A native combined LineI reciprocal glyph was sampled;2⁻¹+1=1.5 independently confirms its width and placement.
